48.original: We, the Raen, left the surface long ago that we might forge ourselves a peaceful life under the sea. Maintaining such serenity, however, is not always easy─my two sons can attest to that.

49.original: From the crack of dawn until dusk they fight. Lately, things have started to escalate and they have begun to trouble the entire village with their spats.

50.original: I have scolded them on multiple occasions, telling them that such disturbing behavior is unacceptable. They, however, still refuse to listen. Perhaps you can try having a word with them?

51.original: You can start with my eldest son. He should be over by the racks of dried fish. If he attempts to start a fight with you when you approach him, I suggest you respond with a resounding <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>huh<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. That should stop him.

52.original: Should he try to start a fight with you, I suggest you look him in the eye and respond with a resounding <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>huh<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

53.original: Huh? What do you want? Stop wasting my time. Hurry up and say what it is you've come to say!

54.original: By his cocky attitude you sense Mahiwa's eldest son is trying to pick a fight with you. You best <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>huh<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> at him before things get any further out of hand.

55.original: I will tell you one last time. If there is something you have come to say to me, say it! If not, begone from my sight!

56.original: By his cocky attitude you sense Mahiwa's eldest son is trying to pick a fight with you. You best <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>huh<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> at him before things get any further out of hand.

57.original: Huh? <hex:021A020203>Huh<hex:021A020103>!? Wh-Who do you think you are to take such a lofty tone with me!? Well, if it is a fight you want, it is a fight you will get!

58.original: But wait... Perhaps this is what Mother meant when she said I had an unpleasant attitude. Now that I think on it, I have often done to my brother what you just did to me. Maybe it's what caused our constant brawls.

59.original: I understand now. Thank you, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>...and my apologies for trying to fight you. If you happen to see my brother, please tell him I am sorry.

60.original: You came to tell me my brother says he is sorry? I do not believe you.

61.original: Mahiwa's younger son appears to be in a sour mood and seems to be looking to take it out on someone. You best <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>huh<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> at him before things get any further out of hand.

62.original: Please, leave me. I just want to be alone!

63.original: Mahiwa's younger son appears to be in a sour mood and seems to be looking to take it out on someone. You best <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>huh<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> at him before things get any further out of hand.

64.original: So my eldest son has finally come around? That is wonderful to hear! I only hope you see the same amount of success when you speak with my younger son.

65.original: What do you─ You did that because I seem grumpy!? No, you misunderstand.

66.original: <sigh> Mother also often comments that I seem sullen. I am not─I simply do not have much to say. Perhaps my brother has also been mistaking my silence for anger and that is why he shouts at me.

67.original: I must go and sort this out with him. Thank you, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. You have made me realize how important it is to let others know what I am thinking. I shall go find my brother now!

68.original: Perhaps now they will be able to find a way to reconcile their differences. Thank you. Until you came along I was at a loss as to what to do.

69.original: By nature, we avoid using any harsh words or actions. As such, most of what I have to say is easily brushed aside by my children.

70.original: You, however, have gotten through to them where I could not. Now the people of the village need not be disturbed by their angry shouts any longer. Please accept this small gift as a token of my appreciation.
